title: feat(app-shell): the served approval request page shows the declared amount and a snapshot summary (objectui#12483)
body:
Fixes #12483
Clause-②: no. The decision panel draws more of the bound row it already reads; no type, prop, export, page node or spec declaration changes.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer). The new part is `RecordSnapshotSummary`, named for what it draws (a record snapshot against its object's declared fields); it is module-internal and registers nothing.

## What changes

The decision panel (`record:approval_decision`), which objectstack's served `sys_approval_request_detail` page already mounts in its `actions` slot, now draws what was submitted above the tally: the declared amount (the first field the target object declares `type: 'currency'`, the first non-zero one, else the first one), then the first six business fields of the request's `payload`, each under its declared label and through the record page's own cell, or by `payload_display` for a resolved reference. Two rows never share a label. No row for: an undeclared key, a framework column, an unresolved reference id, a `hidden: true` field, or a field the reader may not read (`withoutDeniedFields`). Hidden and unreadable fields are dropped before the cut and never lead.

## Fit before build (the ruling's item 2), measured

- `record:approval_decision` carries it: it is already mounted and already reads the bound row, which carries `object_name`, `payload` and `payload_display`.
- `record:details` sections name the bound object's fields, not the target snapshot inside one JSON value: that would need a page edit.
- `RecordPreviewCard` reads the LIVE target by id and draws its `highlightFields`; it is already on the page as the `record_id` pointer card and stays as it is.
- The field renderers and the FLS fold are reused, not changed.

## Mechanism assumptions

A1 holds (the routed row reaches the panel whole on the real `RecordDetailView`). A2 holds: 0 extra network reads in the usual case, at most 1 (the same metadata-store definition the pointer card reads). A3 holds: the server redacts per reader, and the client fold is pinned on the served page with a counter-probe. A4 is matched by assertion, with two boundaries: only a declared `currency` field leads (the sheet's key-name guess is not ported; the showcase's `summary` roll-up totals become ordinary rows), and with no definition there is no summary (the sheet falls back to the raw snapshot).

## Pins

- `apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPageSummary-12483.test.tsx`: 15 tests on the served page, copied whole from objectstack `09dd537193`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/RecordSnapshotSummary.test.tsx`.

## Ablation (one-shot, not kept)

Fix committed first (`e104977`). Dropping the summary element turned 12 tests red and left 30 green (the controls, the unit suite, face 1's suite). Restore was proven: blob equals HEAD.

## Gates

Code readings at `d756d98`; `7f066d7` adds only a README paragraph. Build closure 34/34, app-shell type-check exit 0, console tsc exit 0. Vitest: 70 files, 1566 tests passed, including the ApprovalsInboxPage pins as the CONTROL and 24 census and ratchet suites. All check scripts, changeset gates and eslint exit 0. Not measured locally: `check:readme-exports` (prerequisite: unbuilt packages outside the closure), `pnpm lint`, the test shards, bundle analysis, `check:eager-closure`, `check:sdui-registration-pins`.

## Acceptance notes

The neutral summary logic now lives in the sheet (untouched) and here; the sheet's copy goes when the sheet migrates.

Implemented in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01ARrv23Gwbz3Qwdivy7Yt9p`.
